Rashi on Ketubot 7a:13:1.hebrew: בועז אלמון הוה - דאמר מר: אבצן זה בועז, וכבר היו לו ל' בנים ושלשים בנות, בבבא בתרא (דף צא.):
Rashi on Ketubot 7a:13:1.english: Boaz was a widower - For the Master said: "Ibzan is Boaz," and he already had thirty sons and thirty daughters, in Bava Batra (page 91a).

Rashi on Ketubot 7a:15:1.hebrew: האמרת שבעה - דמדאינה טעונה דקאמר רב הונא אוקימנא דאינה טעונה שבעה, מכלל דטעונה דקאמר רבי אבא שבעה:
Rashi on Ketubot 7a:15:1.english: Didn't you say seven - For since we established [the statement] "She does not require [a blessing]," which Rav Huna stated, as [meaning] that she does not require [it all] seven [days], it follows that [the statement] "She requires [a blessing]," which Rabbi Abba stated, [means] seven [days].

Tosafot on Ketubot 7a:13:1.hebrew: והא בועז אלמון שנשא אלמנה הוה - לאו דוקא אלמנה, דכשנשאת למחלון (וכליון) היתה נכרית; אלא כיון דבעולה היא, כאלמנה חשיב לה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 7a:13:1.english: And was Boaz not a widower who married a widow - [She was] not specifically a widow, for when she married Mahlon (and Chilion), she was a gentile; rather, since she was a non-virgin (be'ulah), [the Gemara] considers her like a widow.
